title: dicranopteris longissima
intro: Dicranopteris longissima, commonly known as Black Ophioglossum or Chinese Chain Fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Ophioglossaceae. It is a perennial plant with a long, creeping stem that resembles a chain, giving it its common name. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever, relieve pain, and protect against cancer and other diseases. The bioactive constituents of Dicranopteris longissima include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-diabetic activities, and may also have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
